Femoral stem incorporating a diamond cubic lattice structure: Design, manufacture and testing.

Bruno Jetté, Vladimir Brailovski, Mathieu Dumas, Charles Simoneau, Patrick Terriault Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2018-01-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2017.08.034
单位: Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Canada H3C1K3. Electronic address: bruno.jette.1@etsmtl.net.
通讯: Bruno Jetté @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca  |  Vladimir Brailovski @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca  |  Mathieu Dumas @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca  |  Charles Simoneau @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca  |  Patrick Terriault @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca
相关性: 该论文直接针对股骨假体的应力遮挡问题，采用金刚石立方晶格多孔结构降低刚度，并通过LPBF制造和力学测试验证，与研究方向的应力遮挡和刚度匹配高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration evaluation, which are key aspects of the research direction.
动机· 解决全髋假体因刚度过大导致的应力遮挡和远期松动问题。
方法· 设计金刚石立方晶格多孔股骨柄，利用LPBF制造并进行ISO标准静力学测试。
结果· 多孔柄刚度比实心柄降低31%，数字图像相关验证了数值模型。
验证· ISO 7206-4静力学实验结合数字图像相关与数值模型对比。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To mitigate stress shielding and aseptic loosening in total hip arthroplasty by reducing femoral stem stiffness via porous lattice design.
Method· A diamond cubic lattice femoral stem was designed, fabricated by laser powder bed fusion from Ti-6Al-4V, and tested under static loading per ISO 7206-4.
Result· The porous stem exhibited a 31% reduction in stiffness compared to its dense counterpart, validated by digital image correlation and numerical modeling.
Validation· Static mechanical testing with digital image correlation and finite element analysis provided experimental-numerical correlation.

Utmattningsegenskaper för Ti-6Al-4V legeringar tillverkade av Selective Laser Melting : Influtandet av mikrostruktur, ytfinhet och ytorientering

Gunnerek, Rasmus KTH Publication Database DiVA (KTH Royal Institute of Technology) 2018-01-01 link
相关性: 该论文直接研究了SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能，包括表面粗糙度和微观结构的影响，对生物医学植入物的疲劳可靠性具有参考价值。
边界: This paper does not link porous structures to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it address osseointegration or in vivo validation.
动机· 研究SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V合金的疲劳性能受微观结构和表面粗糙度的影响。
方法· 进行三点弯曲疲劳测试，比较SLM样品与传统样品，并分析表面形态取向。
结果· SLM样品疲劳寿命仅为传统样品的9%，归因于表面粗糙度引起的应力集中。
验证· 通过三点弯曲机械实验验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate how microstructure, surface roughness, and surface morphology influence the fatigue life of SLM-produced Ti-6Al-4V alloys for biomedical applications.
Method· Three-point bending fatigue tests were conducted on SLM and conventionally manufactured samples, with analysis of surface orientation effects.
Result· SLM samples exhibited only 9% of the fatigue life of conventional samples, attributed to poor surface roughness causing multiple crack nucleation.
Validation· Experimental mechanical testing via three-point bending.

单位: Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Canada H3C1K3. Electronic address: bruno.jette.1@etsmtl.net.
通讯: Bruno Jetté @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca  |  Vladimir Brailovski @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca  |  Charles Simoneau @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca  |  Mathieu Dumas @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca  |  Patrick Terriault @ Ecole de technologie superieure, Department of Mechanical Engineering, 1100 Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, Ca
相关性: 该论文直接研究多孔结构对股骨柄应力遮挡的影响，并使用LPBF制造和力学测试，但缺少疲劳和表面形貌表征。
边界: Paper does not report fatigue testing or surface roughness characterization, and is primarily a numerical model validation with limited experimental novelty.
动机· 减少金属股骨柄的应力遮挡及其导致的骨吸收
方法· 开发简化数值模型，比较密实与多孔股骨柄的应变分布
结果· 多孔柄预测的骨吸收少于密实柄

English summary & terms
Motivation· To reduce stress shielding and subsequent bone resorption caused by stiff metallic femoral stems in total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A simplified numerical model was developed to predict stress shielding by comparing strain distributions between intact and implanted femurs with dense and porous lattice stems fabricated by LPBF.
Result· The porous stem predicted less bone resorption than the dense stem, correlating with reduced stiffness mismatch.
Validation· Numerical predictions were validated against experimental force-displacement curves and displacement/strain fields obtained via digital image correlation on synthetic femurs.

Mechanical and shape memory properties of triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) NiTi structures fabricated by selective laser melting

Saghaian SE, Amirhesam Amerinatanzi, Moghaddam NS, A.J. Majumdar, Mohammadreza Nematollahi et al. Biology Engineering and Medicine 2018-01-01 10.15761/bem.1000152
单位: Smart Materials Laboratory, Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Kentucky, Lexington, KY40506-0503, USA
通讯: Saghaian SE @ Smart Materials Laboratory, Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Kentucky, Lexington, KY40506-0503, USA
相关性: 该论文研究了SLM制备的NiTi TPMS多孔结构的力学和形状记忆性能，与用户关注的多孔结构刚度匹配和LPBF制造相关。
边界: The paper does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding, does not include fatigue testing, and lacks surface roughness or osseointegration characterization.
动机· 通过SLM制造NiTi多孔结构以调控其形状记忆和力学性能，用于植入物。
方法· 采用SLM制备三种TPMS结构（Schwartz、Diamond、Gyroid）并进行表征。
结果· 多孔NiTi表现出7%的可恢复应变和低弹性模量。
验证· 通过力学测试和形貌表征验证性能。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To fabricate NiTi porous structures with tailored shape memory and mechanical properties for biomedical implants via selective laser melting.
Method· Three TPMS geometries (Schwartz, Diamond, Gyroid) were fabricated by SLM and characterized morphologically and mechanically.
Result· Porous NiTi exhibited 7% recoverable strain and low Young's modulus, tunable by porosity.
Validation· Validation through systematic mechanical testing and morphological analysis.

Influence of the finish cutting operations on the fatigue performance of Ti-6Al-4V parts produced by Selective Laser Melting

Maxime Dumas, F. Cabanettes, Radosław Kamiński, Frédéric Valiorgue, E. Picot et al. Procedia CIRP 2018-01-01 10.1016/j.procir.2018.05.054
单位: University of Lyon, ENISE, LTDS CNRS UMR 5513, 58 rue Jean Parot, 42023 Saint-Etienne, France
通讯: J. Rech @ University of Lyon, ENISE, LTDS CNRS UMR 5513, 58 rue Jean Parot, 42023 Saint-Etienne, France
相关性: 该论文研究了SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能与表面加工的关系，对生物医学植入体的表面处理和疲劳评估有参考价值。
边界: This paper does not address porous structures for osseointegration, stress shielding, or biomedical implant context.
动机· 研究精加工对SLM钛合金疲劳性能的影响。
方法· 对SLM态和热处理后的钛合金进行铣削和抛光，测试旋转弯曲疲劳。
结果· 精加工显著提高疲劳强度，但未达到锻件水平；表面形貌偏度与疲劳相关。
验证· 通过疲劳试验和表面完整性（粗糙度、残余应力）分析验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the effect of finish cutting operations on the fatigue performance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V parts.
Method· Milling and polishing were applied to SLM-produced Ti-6Al-4V samples after heat treatment, followed by rotary bending fatigue testing.
Result· Finish machining substantially improved fatigue resistance compared to the as-built state, but could not match the performance of wrought material; surface skewness correlated with fatigue life.
Validation· Fatigue tests combined with surface integrity characterization (roughness, residual stresses) validated the findings.

单位: Materials & Manufacturing Qualification Group, Corporate Technology, Siemens Ltd., China, Beijing 100102, China

相关性: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化Inconel 718的疲劳性能，与生物医学方向的骨植入物疲劳评估方法有潜在可转移性，但未涉及生物材料或多孔结构。
边界: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, and no osseointegration or surface morphology characterization.
动机· 研究选区激光熔化Inconel 718的织构对低周疲劳性能的影响
方法· 通过不同热处理控制晶粒组织并进行低周疲劳测试
结果· 柱状晶样品存在各向异性疲劳性能，等轴晶样品则无

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the effect of crystallographic texture on the low cycle fatigue behavior of Inconel 718 fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· Different heat treatments were applied to modify the grain structure (columnar vs. equiaxed) and low cycle fatigue tests were performed.
Result· Anisotropic low cycle fatigue properties were observed in columnar-grained samples, while no orientation sensitivity was found in equiaxed-grained samples.
Validation· Experimental low cycle fatigue testing with microstructural characterization.

单位: CEMMPRE, Department of Mechanical Enginnering, University of Coimbra, Rua Luís Reis Santos, 3030-788, Coimbra, Portugal

边界: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no surface roughness or osseointegration characterization.
动机· 研究SLM制造Ti6Al4V合金的疲劳性能，为其在生物医学中的应用提供依据。
方法· 采用应变控制疲劳试验，测试光滑和缺口试样，进行拉伸和SEM分析。
结果· 材料呈现应变软化行为，低过渡寿命，缺口敏感因子随寿命增加。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To characterize the fatigue behavior of selective laser melted Ti6Al4V alloy for biomedical applications.
Method· Strain-controlled fatigue tests were conducted on smooth and notched round specimens, with tensile tests and SEM fractography.
Result· The alloy exhibited strain-softening, a low transition life of ~250 reversals, and a notch sensitivity factor increasing with fatigue life.
Validation· Mechanical testing and SEM analysis validated the fatigue properties and failure mechanisms.

Motivation· To compare the osteogenic capacity of mixed-acid and heat-treated SLM titanium mesh with conventional chemical treatment in bone defects.
Method· Treated SLM Ti meshes were implanted into rat calvarial bone defects, and bone formation was evaluated using micro-CT and histology.
Result· Mixed-acid and heat treatment resulted in superior bone formation compared to conventional treatment.
Validation· In vivo validation using a rat calvarial defect model.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of surface roughness on high cycle fatigue life of Ti-6Al-4V parts produced by SLM and EBM.
Method· Fatigue testing coupled with FEM simulations using surface profilometry scans to model stress distributions.

Validation· Combined experimental fatigue tests and numerical simulations.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To overcome the limitations of tensile residual stresses and non-optimal microstructures in Selective Laser Melting (SLM) parts.
Method· Developed a novel hybrid process called 3D Laser Shock Peening (3D LSP) that repeatedly applies LSP during the SLM build phase to introduce compressive residual stresses.
Result· Demonstrated up to 75% reduction in geometrical distortion in Ti6Al4V, a 15-fold increase in fatigue life in 316L steel, and up to 95% crack density reduction in CM247LC superalloy.
Validation· Validated through residual stress measurements, microstructure analysis, fatigue tests, and distortion measurements on various metallic alloys.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To develop a zirconia implant with hierarchical surface roughness for enhanced osseointegration.
Method· Solid-state laser sculpting was used to create meso-/micro-/nano-scale rough surfaces on Y-TZP, followed by in vitro and in vivo evaluations.
Result· The rough zirconia surface significantly upregulated osteogenic gene expression and doubled the osseointegration strength compared to smooth zirconia.
Validation· Osseointegration was validated through rat femur implantation and biomechanical push-in testing.

English summary & terms
Motivation· Conventional titanium plates cause stress shielding due to high elastic modulus, impeding bone repair.
Method· Titanium fiber plates were fabricated by applying compression and shear to titanium fibers at room temperature to achieve a bone-matching elastic modulus.
Result· Implantation in rat bone defects showed that titanium fiber plates facilitated bone tissue repair better than conventional titanium plates.
Validation· In vivo rat bone defect model was used to evaluate the bone repair performance.

Method· Ovariectomized rats on low-calcium diet were treated with alendronate or raloxifene, then received tibial implants; bone was analyzed histologically and by micro-CT.
Result· Raloxifene significantly increased bone-to-implant contacts, mineral apposition rate, and bone volume, whereas alendronate only increased bone volume without improving osseointegration.
Validation· Animal model with histomorphometry, micro-CT, and fluorochrome labeling.

Motivation· To evaluate the precision and feasibility of DXA-based BMD measurements near osseointegrated implants in transfemoral amputees.
Method· Repeated DXA scans on cadaveric femurs with implants at varied flexion/rotation angles, and clinical patient examinations to compute precision errors.

Validation· Cadaveric specimens and clinical repeated measurements.

Motivation· To investigate if extracorporeal shock wave therapy can optimize osseointegration and screw fixation in osteoporotic bone.
Method· Screws were implanted in rat femora and tibiae, with shock wave treatment applied to one side and the other as control, evaluated after 4 weeks.

Validation· MicroCT, histology with fluorochrome labeling, and pull-out tests.

Method· Threaded titanium dental implants were placed in the maxillae of Goettingen minipigs, and paired sections were analyzed via both contact radiography and histology.

Reinhilde Jacobs, Myrthel Vranckx, Tony Vanderstuyft, Marc Quirynen, Benjamin Salmon European journal of oral implantology 2018-01-01 link
相关性: 该论文是关于CBCT与其它影像学方法评估种植体周围骨缺损的诊断价值系统综述，完全不涉及增材制造、力学测试或疲劳性能。

方法· 系统检索MEDLINE、Embase和Web of Science，经QUADAS-2质量评价后纳入9项研究进行定性分析。
结果· CBCT在近远中向缺损检测方面表现与口内X线片相当，但能提供颊舌向三维信息；金属伪影可能掩盖骨整合和浅表缺损。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of cone-beam computed tomography compared to 2D imaging and clinical gold standards for detecting and measuring peri-implant bone defects.
Method· A systematic literature search was conducted in three databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science) up to July 2017; nine clinical, ex vivo, in vitro, and animal studies were included after full-text screening and quality assessment using QUADAS-2.
Result· CBCT showed comparable diagnostic performance to intraoral radiography for mesiodistal defect detection but provided additional buccolingual visualization; however, metal artifacts limited the assessment of osseointegration and shallow defects.
Validation· Validation relied on qualitative synthesis of included studies without quantitative meta-analysis, and the review's conclusions are based on the aggregated evidence from heterogeneous study designs.

Motivation· To determine whether short stem humeral components differ from traditional-length stems in clinical and radiographic outcomes after total shoulder arthroplasty.
Method· A multicenter retrospective review compared 58 traditional-length and 56 short-stem press-fit humeral components with identical geometry and coating, assessing functional outcomes and radiographs at minimum 2-year follow-up.

Validation· Clinical follow-up and radiographic examination over 24 months assessed implant survival and bone level changes.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate a novel osseointegrated transcutaneous implant in a large animal model as a proof of concept for amputee prosthetics.
Method· Four Dorset sheep underwent two-stage surgery to receive osseointegrated transcutaneous implants using Compress® technology, with either long or short anchor plugs.
Result· Short anchor plugs had no fractures and showed osseointegration, while longer plugs caused periprosthetic fractures; no infections or adapter failures occurred.
Validation· Radiographic and histological analysis performed 16 weeks post-surgery confirmed osseointegration in two of three limbs examined.
